mainEntity.name: How do I know if my foreclosed kitchen needs a refresh or a full remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: A light refresh is best when cabinets, counters, and layout are still usable but dirty, dated, or worn. A full remodel makes more sense if the cabinets are failing, there are major water-damage issues, or the layout is so broken that cleaning alone will not improve function or value.
acceptedAnswer.description: If the structure is sound, a refresh may be enough. If cabinets are warped, plumbing is failing, or there is hidden water damage, you may need more than cosmetic updates.
